def: something advanced or deep, i.e. a bowl; figuratively, the bosom

occurrences.text: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
